    | timestamp = 00:11:59.440
    | text      = We've discussed him in great detail in the past.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:01.600
    | text      = So to give a brief refresher, Tommy Robinson is a career violent street agitator and anti
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.399
    | text      = Muslim propagandist who exists solely to attack immigrants and then play the victim to encourage
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:11.039
    | text      = other white people to attack immigrants further.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:13.879
    | text      = We've seen him involved in a number of hoaxes over the years meant to incite rage against
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.519
    | text      = immigrants and he's involved in another one now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:20.639
    | text      = This has to do with the case of Axel Raducabana, a 17 year old from the UK who was charged
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:26.039
    | text      = with killing three young girls at a Southport Taylor Swift themed yoga and dance workshop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.399
    | text      = Obviously the case is horrifying and a complete tragedy and I don't mean to minimize any of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:36.200
    | text      = that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:37.200
    | text      = In the aftermath of the attack and arrest, the details about the perpetrator's identity
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.899
    | text      = were kept private because he was 17, which is normal in the United Kingdom.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:44.960
    | text      = They don't always release these details.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:47.879
    | text      = When he was seen at the Liverpool Crown Court, however, the judge did not impose this prohibition
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:53.279
    | text      = for the case, so the media was able to cover the details about the charged person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:58.120
    | text      = In the meantime, in that period where no one knew any details, right wing anti-immigrant
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:02.279
    | text      = agitators like Tommy Robinson began a campaign to blame migration for these murders.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:07.779
    | text      = They were certain that the attacker was a migrant and if the government had just bowed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:10.879
    | text      = to their white nationalist demands, this guy would have never been there to carry this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:14.799
    | text      = attack out and the fact that they weren't releasing details about him was proof that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:18.759
    | text      = they were covering it up as opposed to him being a 17 year old and them not releasing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:25.000
    | text      = that stuff all the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:26.519
    | text      = This narrative stuck and it prompted days of protest that at times broke out into violence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:31.879
    | text      = However, once the suspect was seen in court and his identity was revealed, it turns out
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:35.759
    | text      = that he was born in Britain, he wasn't an immigrant and has no known connections to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:39.480
    | text      = terrorism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:40.559
    | text      = The folks like Tommy Robinson want to fight.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:43.039
    | text      = They want street violence and they will take or manufacture any opportunity to incite it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:48.320
    | text      = Prime Minister Keir Starmer put it quite well, quote, as far as the far right is concerned,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:53.879
    | text      = this is coordinated.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:55.039
    | text      = This is deliberate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:56.220
    | text      = This is not a protest that just got out of hand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:58.340
    | text      = It's a group of individuals who are absolutely bent on violence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:02.159
    | text      = Tommy Robinson is one of the most high profile people who's absolutely bent on violence and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:06.279
    | text      = he has been for years.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:07.720
    | text      = It's very distressing to see him on this show, particularly at this point, when there's every
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:12.279
    | text      = reason to know that the premise of the outrage that he is the front person for is factually
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:18.659
    | text      = inaccurate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:20.399
    | text      = There's no excuse to associate with Tommy Robinson in 2024.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:25.120
    | text      = You know better.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:26.240
    | text      = You absolutely know better.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:27.919
    | text      = Incidentally, just today, it's coming out that this violence has been spreading.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:32.419
    | text      = In Rotterdam, police face down with a violent crowd trying to storm a hotel where asylum
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:36.600
    | text      = seekers were housed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:38.159
    | text      = This mob sought to kill the migrants housed there and set the building on fire.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:42.840
    | text      = The AP covered the story and said, quote, rallying cries have come from a diffuse group
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:47.039
    | text      = of social media accounts, but a key player in amplifying them is Steven Yaxley-Lennon,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:51.519
    | text      = a long time far right agitator who uses the name Tommy Robinson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:55.399
    | text      = He led the English Defense League, which Mercy Dale Police has linked to the violent protest
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:59.919
    | text      = in Southport on Tuesday, a day after the stabbing attack.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:04.120
    | text      = Tommy Robinson is actively involved in trying to incite real-world violence against migrants
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:08.799
    | text      = in the UK, and it's having its desired effect.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:11.679
    | text      = Alex is an active and eager participant in that effort, which I hope ends up being a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:15.600
    | text      = problem for him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:17.120

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = whether directly or those whipping up this action online and then running away themselves.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:26.720
    | text      = This is not a protest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:27.879
    | text      = It's organized violent thuggery, and it has no place in our streets or online.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = And so Tommy is coming on to basically make things worse.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:15:38.100
    | text      = I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
